<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="teal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#200E32"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#24262B"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="365" fill="url(#teal)"/>
  <path d="M0 302 C82 345 166 300 244 326 C306 347 349 332 390 304 L390 390 L0 390 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="314" y1="21" x2="314" y2="27" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="319" y1="19" x2="319" y2="27" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="324" y1="16" x2="324" y2="27" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="342" cy="22" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="338" y1="22" x2="346" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <rect x="356" y="16" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="359" y="19" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="379" y="20" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- header controls -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="35,78 27,86 35,94" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="28" y1="86" x2="49" y2="86" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="125" r="41" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="181" y="119" width="28" height="23" rx="5" fill="#B4DDDD"/>
    <rect x="187" y="104" width="16" height="19" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="#B4DDDD" stroke-width="4"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="130" r="3" fill="#200E32"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="133" x2="195" y2="137" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="198" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="24" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Verify your phone</text>
  <text x="195" y="226" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#D6D9DD">Enter the 4-digit code sent to</text>
  <text x="195" y="249" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">+1 416 555 0184</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="155" y="269" width="80" height="28" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.12"/>
    <circle cx="171" cy="283" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#A5F59C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="171" y1="280" x2="171" y2="284" stroke="#A5F59C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="182" y="288" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">30 sec</text>
  </g>

  <!-- content panel shadow and panel -->
  <rect x="15" y="326" width="360" height="442" rx="28" fill="#200E32" opacity="0.18" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <rect x="12" y="318" width="366" height="450" rx="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="35" y="363" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Verification code</text>
  <text x="355" y="363" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Required</text>

  <!-- otp fields -->
  <g>
    <rect x="35" y="383" width="68" height="68" rx="14" fill="#F7F8F8" stroke="#A5F59C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="113" y="383" width="68" height="68" rx="14" fill="#F7F8F8" stroke="#D6D9DD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="191" y="383" width="68" height="68" rx="14" fill="#F7F8F8" stroke="#D6D9DD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="269" y="383" width="68" height="68" rx="14" fill="#F7F8F8" stroke="#D6D9DD" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="69" y="428" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">7</text>
    <circle cx="147" cy="417" r="3" fill="#BDBDBD"/>
    <circle cx="225" cy="417" r="3" fill="#BDBDBD"/>
    <circle cx="303" cy="417" r="3" fill="#BDBDBD"/>
  </g>
  <text x="35" y="479" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">The code expires in 30 seconds.</text>
  <text x="35" y="514" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Didn't receive a code?</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="258" y="491" width="100" height="38" rx="19" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D6D9DD" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="308" y="515" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Resend OTP</text>
  </g>

  <!-- continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="35" y="558" width="320" height="52" rx="16" fill="#200E32"/>
    <text x="195" y="591" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
    <polyline points="287,581 294,587 287,593" fill="none" stroke="#A5F59C" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="35" y="628" width="320" height="48" rx="15" fill="#F4F8F1"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="652" r="10" fill="#A5F59C" opacity="0.8"/>
    <polyline points="57,652 60,655 66,648" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="81" y="657" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#434343">Your number is protected and secure</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="35" y1="703" x2="355" y2="703" stroke="#E7E7E7" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="729" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Need help? Contact support</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="780" width="390" height="64" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.96"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="780" x2="390" y2="780" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,805 49,796 59,805 59,816 52,816 52,809 46,809 46,816 39,816" fill="#200E32"/>
    <text x="49" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="804" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="133" y1="810" x2="139" y2="816" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="127" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="185" y="797" width="20" height="15" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="190,812 190,817 196,812" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Messages</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="305" cy="802" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="305" cy="815" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="305" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
